verses: Alif Laam Ra, yeh kitab elahi ki aayaten hain aur khulay aur roshan Quran ki
Woh bhi waqt hoga kay kafir apney musalman honey ki aarzoo keren gay
Aap unhen khata, nafa uthata aur (jhooti) umeedon mein mashghool hota chor dijiye yeh khud abhi jaan len gay
Kissi basti ko hum ney halak nahi kiya magar yeh kay uss kay liye muqarrara navishta tha
Koi giroh apni maut say na aagay barhta hai na peechay rehta hai
Unhon ney kaha kay aey woh shakhs jiss per Quran utara gaya hai yaqeenan to to koi deewana hai
Agar to sacha hi hai to humaray pass farishton ko kiyon nahi laata
Hum farishton ko haq kay sath hi utartay hain aur uss waqt woh mohlat diye gaye nahi hotay
Hum ney hi uss Quran ko nazil farmaya hai aur hum hi uss kay mohafiz hain
Hum ney aap say pehlay agli ummaton mein bhi apney rasool (barabar) bhejay
Aur (lekin) jo bhi rasool aata woh uss ka mazaq uratay
Gunah gaaron kay dilon mein hum ussi tarah yehi racha diya kertay hain
Woh uss per eman nahi latay aur yaqeenan aglon ka tareeqa guzra hua hai
Aur agar hum unn per aasman ka darwaza khol bhi den aur yeh o haan charhney bhi lag jayen
Tab bhi yehi kahen gay kay humari nazar bandi ker di gaee hai balkay)yeh hum logon per jadoo ker diya gaya hai
Yaqeenan hum ney aasman mein burj banaye hain aur dekhney walon kay liye ussay saja diya gaya hai
Aur ussay her mardood shetan say mehfooz rakha hai
Haan magar jo chori chupay sunnay ki koshish keray uss kay peechay dehakta hua (khulla shola) lagta hai
Aur zamin ko hum ney phela diya hai aur uss per (atal) pahar daal diye hain, aur uss mein hum ney her cheez aik moyyen miqdaar say uga di hai
Aur ussi mein hum ney tumhari roziyan bana di hain aur jinhen tum rozi denay walay nahi ho
Aur jitni bhi cheezen hain unn sab kay khazaney humaray pass hain, aur hum her cheez ko uss kay muqarrara andaz say utartay hain
Aur hum bhejtay hain bojhal hawayen, phir aasman say pani barsa ker woh tumhen pilatay hain aur tum uss ka zakheera kerney walay nahi ho
Hum hi jilatay aur maartay hain aur hum hi (bil-aakhir) waris hain
Aur tum mein say aagay barhney walay aur peechay hatney walay bhi humaray ilm mein hain
Aap ka rab sab logon ko jama keray ga yaqeenan woh bari hikmaton wala baray ilm wala hai
Yaqeenan hum ney insan ko kali aur sarhi hui khankhanati mitti say, peda farmaya hai
Aur uss say pehlay jinnat ko hum ney lo wali aag say peda kiya
Aur jab teray perwerdigar ney farishton say farmaya kay mein aik insan ko kali aur sarhi hui khankhanati mitti say peda kerney wala hun
To jab mein ussay poora bana chukon aur uss mein apni rooh phoonk doon to tum sab uss kay liye sajday mein gir parna
Chunacha tamam farishton ney sab kay sab ney sajdah ker liya
Magar Iblees kay. Kay uss ney sajdah kerney walon mein shamooliyat kerney say (saaf) inkar ker diya
(Allah Taalaa ney) farmaya aey Iblees tujhay kiya hua kay to sajdah kerney walon mein shamil na hua?
Woh bola kay mein aisa nahi kay uss insan ko sajdah keroon jissay tu ney kali aur sarhi hui khankhanati mitti say peda kiya hai
Farmaya abb to bahisht say nikal jaa kiyon kay to randa raand-e-dargah hai
Aur tujh per meri phitkaar hai qayamat kay din tak
Kehney laga kay aey meray rab! mujhay uss din tak ki dheel dey kay log doobara utha kharay kiye jayen
Farmaya kay acha to unn mein say hai jinhen mohlat mili hai
Roz muqarrar kay waqt tak ki
(shetan ney) kaha kay aey meray rab! chunkay tu ney mujhay gumrah kiya hai mujhay bhi qasam hai kay mein bhi zamin mein unn kay liye ma’asi ko muzayyan keroon ga aur unn sab ko behkaon ga bhi
Siwaye teray unn bandon kay jo muntakhib ker liye gaye hain
Irshad hua kay haan yehi mujh tak phonchney ki seedhi raah hai
Meray bandon per tujhay koi ghalba nahi, lekin haan jo gumrah log teri pairwee keren
Yaqeenan unn sab kay waday ki jagah jahannum hai
Jiss kay saat darwazay hain. Her darwazay kay liye unn ka aik hissa bata hua hai
Perhezgar jannati log baghon aur chashmon mein hun gay
(unn say kaha jaye ga) salamti aur aman kay sath uss mein dakhil ho jao
Unn kay dilon mein jo kuch ranjish-o-keena o keena tha, hum sab kuch nikal den gay, woh bhai bhai banay huye aik doosray kay aamney samney takhton per bethay hun gay
Na to o haan unhen koi takleef chu sakti hai aur na woh o haan say kabhi nikalay jayen gay
Meray bandon ko khabar dey do kay mein boht hi bakhshney wala aur bara hi meharban hun
Aur sath hi meray azab bhi nihayat dard-naak hain
Unhen Ibrahim kay mehmanon ka (bhi) haal suna do
Kay jab unhon ney unn kay pass aaker salam kaha to unhon ney kaha kay hum ko to tum say darr lagta hai
Unhon ney kaha daro nahi, hum tujhay aik sahib-e-eman ilm farzand ki bisharat detay hain
Kaha, kiya uss burhapay kay aajaney kay baad tum mujhay khushkhabri detay ho! yeh khushkhabri tum kaisay dey rahey ho?
Unhon ney kaha hum aap ko bilkul sachi khushkhabri sunatay hain aap mayyus logon mein shamil na hun
Kaha apney rab Taalaa ki rehmat say na-umeed to sirf gumrah aur behkay huye log hi hotay hain
Poocha kay Allah kay bhejay huye (farishto!) tumhara aisa kiya eham kaam hai?
Unhon ney jawab diya kay hum mujrim qom ki taraf bhejay gaye hain
Magar khandan Loot kay hum unn sab ko to zaroor bacha len gay
Siwaye uss (Loot) ki biwi kay kay hum ney ussay rukney aur baqi reh janey walon mein muqarrar ker diya hai
Jab bhejay huye farishtay aal Loot kay pass phonchay
To unhon (Loot alaihi as-salam) ney kaha tum log to kuch anjan say maloom ho rahey ho
Unhon ney kaha nahi balkay)yeh hum teray pass woh cheez laye hain jiss mein yeh log shak shuba)yeh ker rahey thay
Hum to teray pass (sareeh) haq laye hain aur hain bhi bilkul sachay

Abb to apney khandan samet uss raat kay kissi hissa mein chal dey aur aap unn kay peechay rehna, aur (khabardaar) tum mein say koi (peechay) mur ker bhi na dekhay aur jahan ka tumhen hukum kiya jaraha hai o haan chalay jana
Aur hum ney uss ki taraf uss baat ka faisla ker diya kay subha hotay hotay unn logon ki jaren kaat di jayen gi
Aur shehar walay khushiyan manatay huye aaye
(Loot alaihi as-salam ney) kaha yeh log meray mehaman hain tum mujhay ruswa na kero
Allah Taalaa say daro aur mujhay ruswa na kero
Woh bolay kiya hum ney tujhay duniya bhar (ki thekaydaari) say mana nahi ker rakha?
(Loot alaihi as-salam ney) kaha agar tumhen kerna hi hai to yeh meri bachiyan mojood hain
Teri umar ki qasam! woh to apni bad-masti mein sir-gardan thay
Pus sooraj nikaltay nikaltay unhen aik baray zor ki awaz ney pakar liya
Bil-aakhir hum ney uss shehar ko upper talay ker diya aur unn logon per kankar walay pathar barsaye
Bila-shuba baseerat walon kay liye uss mein boht si nishaniyan hain
Yeh basti aisi raah per hai jo barabar chalti rehti (aam guzargaah) hai.
Aur uss mein eman walon kay liye bari nishani hai
Aikah basti kay rehney walay bhi baray zalim thay
Jin say (aakhir) hum ney intiqam ley hi liya. Yeh dono shehar khulay (aam) raastay per hain
Aur hijr walon ney bhi rasoolon ko jhutlaya
Aur hum ney unn ko apni nishaniyan bhi ata farmaeen (lekin) tahum woh unn say roo-gardani hi kertay rahey
Yeh log paharon ko taraash taraash ker ghar banatay thay, bey khof hoker
Aakhir unhen bhi subha hotay hotay chinghaar dabocha
Pus unn ki kissi tadbeer-o-amal ney unhen koi faeedah na diya

Hum ney aasmano aur zamin ko aur unn kay darmiyan ki sab cheezon ko haq kay sath hi peda farmaya hai, aur qayamat zaroor zaroor aaney wali hai. Pus to husn-o-khoobi o khoobi (aur achai) say darguzar ker ley
Yaqeenan tera perwerdigar hi peda kerney wala aur jannay wala hai
Yaqeenan hum ney aap ko saat aayaten dey rakhi hain kay dohraee jati hain aur azeem Quran bhi dey rakha hai

Aap her gaz apni nazren uss cheez ki taraf na dorayen, jiss say hum ney unn mein say kaee qasam kay logon ko behra mand ker rakha hai, na unn per aap afsos keren aur mominon kay liye apney bazoo jhukaye rahen
Aur keh dijiye kay mein to khullam khulla daraney wala hun
Jaisay kay hum ney unn taqseem kerney walon per utara
Jinhon ney uss kitab elahi kay tukray tukray ker diye
Qasam hai teray paalney walay ki! hum unn sab say zaroor baaz purs keren gay
Her uss cheez ki jo woh kertay thay
Pus aap uss hukum ko jo aap ko kiya jaraha hai khol ker suna dijiye! aur mushrikon say mun pher lijiye
Aap say jo log maskhra kertay hain unn ki saza kay liye hum kafi hain
Jo Allah kay sath doosray mabood muqarrar kertay hain unhen unqareeb maloom ho jaye ga
Humen khoob ilm hai kay unn ki baaton say aap ka dil tang hota hai
Aap apney perwerdigar ki tasbeeh aur hamd biyan kertay rahen aur sajdah kerney walon mein shamil ho jayen
Aur apney rab ki ibadat kertay rahen yahan tak kay aap ko maut aajaye
